name: Distilled Feature Fields
definition: A 3D neural feature field that maps every 3D coordinate to a semantic feature descriptor, enabling query-based local editing of NeRF scenes by semantically decomposing 3D space without re-training.
summary: Distilled Feature Fields extend NeRFs with a 3D semantic feature field distilled from 2D teachers, enabling efficient, open-set query-based editing without retraining.
